scope: Released item/entity/helper bytecode,unmodified loot JSON,vanilla loot/callback comparisons,and original bounded probability/persistence models. No game execution. Forge hooks,spawn success,save migration and current Enderloom acceptance are separate.
probability_scope: One uniformly selected winner among five successfully spawned choices,one ordinary choice,and the unmodified single-roll table with default quality0 and no additional hooks. The separate Lotto Banner is added by the callback after table loot.

persistence_model.scope: Models only the two reversed custom callbacks. Entity UUID/base fields and actual Forge serialization are not simulated.
